Hi Elena,

Thank you for your questions about booking BR-1042.

1. Biscuit: Dogs are welcome up to 40 lbs, with a maximum of 2 dogs per room, so she's welcome. The pet fee is $75 per stay and is non-refundable [P1]. Dogs aren't allowed at the pool or in the restaurant [P1]. We've noted her on your booking.

2. Late check-out: Your Gold membership gives you late check-out until 2:00 PM, subject to availability [P8]. I've sent your request for Monday 9 November to a manager, who will review it and reply. Please note that weekend check-outs are capped at 12:00 PM, so this only applies to Monday.

3. Airport pickup: We can arrange a sedan from MIA for up to 3 guests at $65 one way. Transfers must be booked at least 24 hours in advance [P11]. I've passed your flight details (landing 2:15 PM, Friday 6 November) to our concierge team, who will confirm the booking with you.

The team will confirm the final total for your stay.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

final_text:
Hola Sofía,

Gracias por escribirnos. Sobre su reserva del 20 al 22 de noviembre (habitación Standard Queen, 2 noches):

- Desayuno: sí, está incluido. Se sirve un desayuno continental de 7:00 a 10:00 a. m. en el Great Room. El lodge no tiene restaurante ni servicio a la habitación, aunque se puede pedir comida de restaurantes locales a la recepción [P1].
- Gato: lamentablemente no podemos recibir gatos ni otras mascotas que no sean perros. Nuestra política permite perros de cualquier tamaño, hasta 2 por habitación, con una tarifa de $50 por noche por habitación, con un máximo de $200 por estancia [P4].

Quedamos a su disposición para cualquier otra consulta.

Saludos cordiales,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Hello Laura,

Parking is valet only, at $45 per night with in/out privileges. There are two EV charging spots, first come first served [P6].

If you'd like to check December availability, just send us your preferred dates and we'll be glad to help.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Dear Ethan,

Thank you for your email. Your check-out on Monday, 16 November 2026 is at 11:00 AM, the standard time [P1]. As a Platinum member, you are entitled to late check-out until 4:00 PM on that day [P11]. The weekend cap of 2:00 PM does not apply to a Monday [P4].

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Thank you for your email. Your upcoming stay (booking ML-2034, 27–29 November) is at our Mountain Lodge, not Beach Resort, so here is the parking information for that property.

Parking at Mountain Lodge is free self-parking; it is not valet. RVs and trailers must use the overflow lot, and the front desk can give you directions if needed [P1].

We look forward to welcoming you.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

text:
Hi Hannah,

Thank you for your email. Your upcoming stay (booking ML-2034, 27–29 November) is at our Mountain Lodge, not Beach Resort, so here is the parking information for that property.

Parking at Mountain Lodge is free self-parking; it is not valet. RVs and trailers must use the overflow lot, and the front desk can give you directions if needed [P1].

We look forward to welcoming you.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

final_text:
Hi Elena,

Thank you for your email, and we look forward to welcoming you and Biscuit on Friday 6 November.

1. Dogs: Dogs up to 40 lbs are welcome, so Biscuit is fine. The pet fee is $75 per stay and is non-refundable. Dogs are not allowed at the pool or in the restaurant. [P1]

2. Late check-out: As a Gold member, you are eligible for check-out until 2:00 PM [P8], subject to availability. Our weekend cap does not apply to a Monday departure. I've asked our front desk to confirm this for your Monday 9 November check-out.

3. MIA pickup: We can arrange a sedan ($65 one way, up to 3 guests) for the two of you. Transfers must be booked at least 24 hours in advance [P11]. I've passed your request to our reservations team, who will confirm the pickup time and total with you.

A manager will review any further requests. Please reply if you have any questions.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Thanks so much!
Elena

final_text:
Hello Laura,

Thank you for reaching out about your December trip.

Unfortunately, dogs are only welcome at Beach Resort up to 40 lbs, with a maximum of 2 dogs per room [P1], so a 60 lb Labrador would not be permitted. Service animals are always welcome with no fee [P1].

Parking is valet only, at $45 per night with in/out privileges [P6].

Yes, there is a resort fee of $35 per night plus tax. It includes Wi-Fi, bike rental and two bottles of water per day [P4].

If you'd like to check room availability for your December dates, please share your check-in and check-out dates and we will look into it for you.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Hi Owen,

Sorry about the trouble with the Wi-Fi in your cabin, especially with work calls coming up. I've asked our maintenance team to check the connection in Cabin C5 and get back to you.

In the meantime, the signal is weaker in the cabins, and a free range extender is available at the front desk [P1]. The network is MountainLodge-Guest, and the password is printed on your key card sleeve [P1]. Please stop by the front desk and we can set one up for you.

If you need a quieter spot for a call, let us know and we'll help you find one.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Thanks for reaching out. Mountain Lodge does not have an on-site pool, so there is no rooftop pool to heat or to keep open in the evening. [P1] Guests do receive free day passes to a partner fitness center 0.5 miles away, which has an indoor pool. [P1]

If you have any other questions, just let us know.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

citations: Mountain Lodge policies › Pets > Mountain Lodge - Property Policies > Pets
final_text:
Hola Lucía,

Gracias por escribirnos. En Mountain Lodge somos un lugar pet-friendly: se admiten perros de cualquier tamaño, con un máximo de 2 por habitación. La tarifa de mascotas es de $50 por noche y por habitación, con un tope de $200 por estancia [P1]. final_text:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for your note, and we look forward to welcoming you and your dogs on 13 November (booking ML-2015).

Pets: We're dog-friendly, with up to 2 dogs of any size per room. The pet fee is $50 per night per room, capped at $200 per stay [P1]. Dog beds and bowls are available on request.

Early check-in: Standard check-in is 3:00 PM [P7]. Early check-in depends on which rooms are ready and is never guaranteed in advance [P6]. We've passed your request for around 12:00 PM to our front desk, who will confirm with you.

Airport shuttle: The shuttle to and from Asheville Regional Airport is $35 per person one way, running hourly from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and must be booked at least 12 hours ahead [P10]. We've sent your request for three guests on arrival at about 11:00 AM on Friday to our concierge team to book. They will confirm the booking and the total with you.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

final_text:
Hola Sofía,

Gracias por escribirnos. Sobre su reserva ML-2021 (Standard Queen, viernes 20 y sábado 21 de noviembre, check-out domingo 22):

¿Desayuno? Sí, un desayuno continental está incluido en todas las tarifas, de 7:00 a 10:00 AM en el Great Room. No tenemos restaurante ni servicio a la habitación, aunque se pueden entregar comidas de restaurantes locales en recepción [P1].

¿Mascotas? Lamentablemente, en Mountain Lodge solo admitimos perros; los gatos y otras mascotas no están permitidos [P4]. Por eso no podemos aceptar a su gato en esta reserva.

Quedo a su disposición para cualquier otra consulta.

Guest Services, Mountain Lodge

Hello Laura,

Thank you for reaching out about your December trip!

Unfortunately, our dog policy does not accommodate a 60 lb Labrador. Dogs are welcome up to 40 lbs, with a maximum of 2 dogs per room. The pet fee is $75 per stay and is non-refundable [P1]. Dogs are not permitted at the pool or in the restaurant [P1]. Service animals are always welcome with no fee [P1].

Parking is valet only at $45 per night, with in/out privileges. There are two EV charging spots, first come first served [P6].

There is a resort fee of $35 per night plus tax. It includes Wi-Fi, bike rental and two bottles of water per day [P3].

If you'd like to discuss your plans further, just reply to this email. Our team is happy to help.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Dear Mr. Park,

Thank you for your message about your arrival on Friday 13 November (booking BR-1088).

Unfortunately, we can't guarantee a 10 AM check-in. Guaranteed early check-in is not offered at the Beach Resort [P1], and early check-in before the standard 3:00 PM depends on which rooms are ready and is never guaranteed at booking [P2]. As a Platinum member, you do get early check-in from 1:00 PM at no charge, subject to availability [P1].

If you arrive early, the front desk can store your luggage free of charge before check-in [P2], so you can leave your bags while you wait for your room.

We'll note your early arrival time in your booking so the team can prepare, but we can't confirm an earlier room time. Please let us know your expected arrival time if you'd like us to pass it along.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort

Un saludo,
Guest Services, Mountain Lodge
